seo_title: Frnds Menu — pizza, pasta, breakfast, coffee in Astana
seo_description: Pizza on our own dough, pasta, all-day breakfast, specialty coffee. Astana, 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov St, daily 09:00–23:00. Order on WhatsApp.
intro: Everything we cook every day: pizza on 48-hour fermented dough, pasta, breakfast, coffee and drinks. Prices are current, and your order goes straight to our WhatsApp — we'll deliver it hot, pack it for pickup or hold you a table.
